title: Cache Key
statement: Implement `solve(cached_lock, new_lock)`. Both are lockfile hashes. Return `reuse` when they are equal and non-empty. Return `rebuild` when they differ or either is empty.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A CI cache of the virtualenv is safe only when the lockfile that produced it is the lockfile you have now.

editorial: A CI cache of the virtualenv is safe only when the lockfile that produced it is the lockfile you have now. Keying the cache on the lock hash makes a dependency bump rebuild. Reusing a cache from a different lock tests the old graph and can go green for the wrong reason.
